label: SIMULATED — NOT A REAL TEST
cleanup_scope: only the run-owned temporary fixture tree

steps.title: Simulate host loss
steps.detail: Deleted only the synthetic source directory; restoration uses the copied local bundle.

steps.title: Rebuild Proxmox/network/VMs
steps.detail: Constructed nine JSON VM records on a documentation-only lab network; no hypervisor or network changes.

steps.title: Recreate K3s
steps.detail: Mock adapter created two groups of three Ready node records; Terraform/Ansible/K3s were not executed.

steps.title: Recover configuration/Secrets
steps.detail: Restored fixture-only configuration with private file permissions from the independent local bundle.

steps.title: Restore database backup
steps.detail: Copied and opened a real SQLite fixture; no PostgreSQL, CNPG, R2 or original cluster access.

steps.title: Point-in-time recovery
steps.detail: Synthetic SQL event replay to fixture time 30 includes time-20 marker and excludes time-40 marker; not PostgreSQL WAL replay.

steps.title: Restore FastAPI/React
steps.detail: In-process application adapter reads the recovered fixture; no FastAPI/React server started.

steps.title: Restore ArgoCD
steps.detail: Pinned fixture desired state equals observed mock state, with automation disabled; no ArgoCD instance.

steps.title: Restore Jenkins
steps.detail: Preserved mock job/build records in held state; no Jenkins runtime or real credential decryption.

steps.title: Restore monitoring
steps.detail: Validated fixture target list and simulated local alert/resolution; no Prometheus/Grafana/Alertmanager services.

steps.title: Routing/HTTPS
steps.detail: Checked a mock Host/SNI mapping and synthetic TLS metadata; no HAProxy or TLS handshake.

steps.title: Authentication/health/CRUD
steps.detail: Valid/invalid fixture token checks and actual SQLite CRUD passed; no deployed application/API tested.

steps.title: RPO/RTO
steps.detail: Synthetic loss time 35 minus last recoverable event 20 gives 15 fixture units. Local elapsed time is not infrastructure RTO.

steps.title: Lab rollback
steps.detail: Filesystem lab restored exactly to the pre-change checkpoint hash manifest.

steps.title: Lab cleanup
steps.detail: Only owned synthetic lab removed; copied archive hashes unchanged. TemporaryDirectory then removes this exercise fixture tree.
